description: The Excel-style fill handle of the Svelte 5 data grid: drag the corner square of a selected range to extend it and the engine detects the pattern. One source cell copies its value, a numeric progression continues the series, dates and weekdays advance, and anything else repeats cyclically, in both directions and horizontally. Nothing to wire beyond enableCellSelection; the demo walks through every case with a caption.

faq.question: How do I turn on the fill handle?
faq.answer: Enable cell selection with enableCellSelection and inline editing so cells can be written. The green corner handle appears on the active range automatically.

faq.question: Which patterns does the fill detect?
faq.answer: A single cell is copied; two or more numbers continue the arithmetic series (10, 20 gives 30, 40); dates and weekday names step forward; other values repeat in order. Dragging up or left reverses the series.

faq.question: Can I keep a column read-only?
faq.answer: Yes. Set editable: false on the column and the fill skips it; the demo's case column is protected that way.
